verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's own docs say the Relay Proxy connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API and proxies that connection to clients. Independent users confirm that SDK clients download all flags on connect and then receive changes over server-sent events (SSE) with minimal latency. That covers the core of streaming propagation, but no first-party evidence states a propagation time in seconds, describes a fast-polling fallback, or confirms that a kill-switch flip reliably reaches all connected SDKs. missing for 10: documented propagation latency (seconds-level SLA or measurement), fast-polling mode/fallback documentation, explicit kill-switch behavior evidence, first-party SDK streaming docs beyond the Relay Proxy.
